# R5.31 — Ordinary contribution and failure-report routes

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/201_R5.31__contrib.md` (seq 201/246) · §8.1 of
`docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` · **Requirement ids:** REQ-A-205,
REQ-B-004 (primary ownership) · **Landing record:** ADR-0409

## Summary

Wires the §8.1 **ordinary contribution and failure-report routes**
over the landed surfaces (ADR-0409): CONTRIBUTING.md carries
separate lanes — a **no-run** bug/setup failure report, an
**existing-run/receipt** report (native `hh run export` /
`hh bundle validate` locator **or** the access/loss reason —
suppressing it blocks), **docs** changes, the **optional packaged
component** and **scientific replication** routes (both explicitly
gated, not open), and **verifyfixed** (failed receipt → candidate
fix preserved; unable-to-reproduce ≠ fixed) — with actual
owner/check/privacy expectations per lane and no internal
Q/ledger/manifest ritual for ordinary contributors. The bug issue
form mirrors the documented fields (`exit`, dirty-state, toolchain/
features/backend, optional `receipt`) plus a required `cleared`
sanitization attestation; CODEOWNERS wording reconciled with owner
review kept. `scripts/check-contributing.sh` is a both-modes static
check (work + `--head` committed-HEAD clone) with 12 check ids —
`commands_real` derives the cited-command contract from `cli.rs`
dispatch arms, never a second table — plus a 20-leg fixture
self-test and a `ci-mode: both` CI step. No Rust, schema,
dependency or card changes; $0 spend; offline only.

## What changed

- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — `### Report a failure without a run`,
  `### Report a wrong run or receipt`, `### Before you attach
  evidence`, `### Propose a change`, `### Show a fix works:
  verifyfixed`, `### Two routes that are not open yet`, `### Where
  a contribution lands` (lane→owner→checks starter map). The
  manifest subsection stays scoped to assigned tickets — never a
  prerequisite on an ordinary PR.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml` — `exit` (code/signal),
  dirty-state on `commit`, toolchain/features/backend/prerequisites
  on `context`, optional `receipt` (ids + native-export locator or
  access/loss reason), required `cleared` attestation.
- `CODEOWNERS` — comment reconciled with the routes doc; owner
  review preserved verbatim (the spec's governance-preserving
  clause).
- `scripts/check-contributing.sh` — static checker, no
  build/network. Check ids: `lanes`, `no_run`, `receipt`,
  `privacy`, `verifyfixed`, `no_ritual`, `gated`, `form_fields`,
  `codeowners`, `commands_real`, `blocked`, `links`. `--head`
  re-runs the identical validation inside a clean clone of
  committed HEAD (the check-quickstart precedent — uncommitted
  edits are never the tested head). Ends `live: skipped(…)`.
- `scripts/ci/test-check-contributing.sh` — fixture self-test,
  20 legs (seeded pass; 15 mutation legs rejected; `--head` dirt
  immunity + committed-drift failure; stripped `ci-mode`
  annotation fails `check-ci-gating.sh`; real tree green).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — the self-test leg and a
  `# ci-mode: both — …` step "Contribution routes static check"
  beside the examples lane (it reads committed CONTRIBUTING/
  `.github` content and resolves links into `docs/`). The anchor
  pair, classifier and dispatch cadence are unchanged.
- ADR-0409 + regenerated `docs/adr/README.md` /
  `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` (193 ADRs); ADR-0409 placed in BL-47's
  `sources` cell; dated coverage note for REQ-A-205/REQ-B-004
  (seq 201, N1–N6) + seven contributing-only stamps.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**552–604 changed source/test lines vs the ≤550 trigger
(~1.0–1.1×) — the smallest-margin case in the build** (narrowest
numstat count — the two scripts plus the workflow edit — is 552;
the inclusive count with the issue form and CODEOWNERS is 604;
the packet's own estimate ceiling equals the bound) — recorded
Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling `8c993df1`
(`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.31-split-review.md`):
adoption packet item 6 CONTRIB binds "no-run reports, verifyfixed
and starter ownership" to one owner unit with one estimate
(350–550) and no contingency (contrast the packet's verbatim
contingency clauses elsewhere); decomposition seq 201 is one row
and the owner-seam table has no R5.31 row; the planning doc's
weak seams are all execution/methods-domain (two already
consumed); a docs-first split is non-curative (AC-2's negative
predicates and AC-3's numbered checks sit in the unlanded leg);
the checker-vs-self-test cut is an impl-vs-battery split (the
R5.14 rule); trimming ~60 lines to duck the bound strips contract
documentation — contract erosion, not a seam. Honest trip at the
noise floor: review, not redesign.
